EmailTemplate.subject: ITA - FAQ Unable to Schedule Call
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Unfortunately, due to the unpredictable nature of support calls, we are unable to schedule a specific call time for our technicians. If you would like to call in (1-800-314-8223) at your convenience and reference this case number ({!Case.CaseNumber}), a member of our live support team will be happy to assist immediately. Otherwise, all requests are answered in the order received so a member of our support team will reach out to assist you as soon as they are able.
We look forward to hearing from you.
Thank you,
Technical Support Team
8401 Greenway Blvd. Suite 1100 | Middleton, WI 53562 OFFICE: 800-314-8223 | FAX: 262-364-3800
